summary.en: Senior JavaScript for Vue and React interviews: array methods, promises, the event loop, scope, and cancellation. Start with section 1.1; interviewers drill the event loop and async/await almost every round.

summary.en: Senior TypeScript is making illegal states unrepresentable: unions, generics you can constrain, and DTOs that cannot send passwordHash. Start with 2.1; interviewers drill discriminated unions and lying fetch helpers.

summary.en: Senior CSS is who owns the page: Grid the chrome, Flex the toolbar, min-width 0 on the child that must shrink, and reserve size before load so CLS stays in budget. Start with 3.1–3.3.

summary.en: Senior Vue 3.5 is compiler-informed UI, reactivity edges, and architecture: hoist versus fetch, provide versus store, client-only. Start with 5.1; interviewers drill patch flags, lost tracking, and SSR fetch.
summary.vi: Vue 3.5 mức senior là UI được compiler thông tin, điểm mép reactivity, và kiến trúc: hoist so với fetch, provide so với store, client-only. Bắt đầu từ 5.1; người phỏng vấn đào patch flag, mất tracking, và fetch SSR.

summary.en: Senior Nuxt 3.x / 4 is a hybrid rendering policy under SEO, auth, TTFB, and server cost — then payload keys, hydration, and Nitro when that policy fails. Start with 6.1–6.3.
